title: One runner for ffmpeg and ffprobe
description: Media tools are run from eleven places in three packages, with different policies on output and on stopping.
acceptanceCriteria: exec.Command appears in product code only in internal/mediatool
A worker killed with SIGKILL during a scan's probe and during a chapter-picture job leaves no ffmpeg or ffprobe process after one second
The 'any output is a failure' and 'warnings allowed' policies are named options, each with a unit test
